protocol.reference: reference GT, already in reference_scan_world; no extra transform
protocol.rescan: prepared rescan GT, already transformed into reference_scan_world
protocol.label_source: gt_seg_reference_all_things; class-agnostic 3000+original objectId, zero remains unknown
protocol.strong_support_rule: At least 80% of all frozen points AND 80% of cumulative conflict points match change-labelled reference GT within 5 cm; descriptive grouping, not an official metric
protocol.mixed_rule: At least 50% of cumulative conflict points match change-labelled GT, but strong-support rule fails
protocol.denominator: ALL points in each selected region, including unmatched and unlabelled points
caveats: A change-labelled object is not necessarily entirely removed.
Not change-labelled is not proof of physical stability.
No nearby rescan GT vertex is not proof of observed free space.
Prepared all-things labels omit structural surfaces; zero is not a static negative.
Frozen candidates may mix old/new surfaces and several GT objects.
